shortBio.en: Who lead vocalist; shout and sustained belt across singles and rock-opera roles.
shortBio.zh: The Who 主唱；单曲与摇滚歌剧角色中的喊唱与延音。

body.en: Born 1944, London. Lead voice on Who records and tours. Mic-swing stage move sits with Townshend’s windmill as the band’s live image.
body.zh: 1944 年生于伦敦。Who 唱片与巡演主声线。甩麦舞台动作与 Townshend 风车一起构成现场形象。
